title: AV Gen Quality Lab report, schema 1
description: The output of `avgen_quality analyze`. Committed so nothing depends on ad-hoc output (mandate §19, ADR-250). Three shapes here are decisions rather than conveniences: there is no field anywhere that holds a composite score; `findings` (measurements) and `hypotheses` (inferences) are separate arrays with different required fields, so nothing can promote one to the other by accident; and every metric carries `available` and `limitations` so an absent tool or a known blind spot travels with the number instead of being omitted or defaulted to zero.

gitCommit.description: A reference is not stable across engine versions -- a renderer upgrade changes pixels on purpose -- so a report without its commit is not reproducible.

targetProfile.description: Quality is conditional on delivery. Two numbers taken under different profiles are not comparable and `compare` refuses to rank them.

frameStride.description: A subsampled run may not be cited as a regression check (metrics.md §5).

candidateSequenceHash.description: From RenderJob. Two arms expected to differ that hash identically are vacuous, and the experiment is void rather than measured (ADR-182).

contentionWitness.description: ADR-170: a timing is evidence only if the device was also quiet. A run that cannot say so reports its milliseconds as a record of having taken them, not as a measurement.

gpuFrameMsMin.description: MIN over a long run, from gpu::FrameTimeline. Contention is never negative. Never summed with cpuPhaseMsMin -- one is GPU timestamps and the other is CPU wall clock on one thread.

cpuPhaseMsMin.description: MIN over a long run, from core::PhaseProfiler.

name.description: Named for what it COMPUTES, not for the artifact it is believed to indicate. ADR-243: 'temporal stability' was the label, 'temporal alternation of the luminance signal' was the measurement, and 'spatial aliasing on moving geometry' was the artifact -- three things wearing one name is how a correct measurement came to rank two remedies backwards.

reason.description: Required when available is false. A metric whose tool or input is absent reports this; it is never omitted and never defaulted to zero.

source.description: WHICH FILE the number came from. A PSNR on EXRs and a PSNR on PNGs are different numbers about different images.

valueNote.description: JSON has no infinity. PSNR of an identical pair is infinite and that is the alignment test passing, so it is named rather than silently becoming null.

worstFrameIndex.description: Never a mean alone: a three-frame pop in three hundred frames is invisible in a mean, and popping is an artifact class the Lab hunts.

findings.description: MEASURED FACT. A number and a region. No cause, no adjective, no recommendation.

hypotheses.description: INFERRED CAUSE, labelled. Carries its evidence and a confidence. Nothing automatic promotes a hypothesis to a finding, which is why these are different arrays with different required fields rather than one array with a flag.

diagnostics.description: Relative paths to the images written beside this report. Mandatory, not a feature: a post chain judged on its final frame cannot be debugged, and neither can a quality vector judged on its pooled numbers (docs/post-artifact-forensics.md).
